claims.text: The baseline model achieved Proportional F1 scores of .41, .31, and .31 for Holders, Targets, and Polar Expressions, respectively, and Binary F1 scores of .41, .36, and .56.
The results indicate that the domain variation between documents leads to lower overlap between training and test data, with overlaps of 56%, 28%, and 50% for Holders, Targets, and Polar Expressions.
The experimental results serve as a preliminary benchmark for further experiments in fine-grained sentiment analysis.
